scenes.title: A controlled path from terms to proof

Finalized capture fixes entitlements; full reserve and separate approval precede execution.
Each redemption payment and burn share one transaction.

scenes.title: Four completed actions. Final supply: zero.

Maturity pays twenty one thousand and burns the remaining twenty bonds.
Final supply is zero.

scenes.title: Explore the live operator interface
sentences: This is Lifecycle KASE, a corporate action terminal for tokenized bonds.
We are using the running application in English, through walletless QA.
These interactions simulate all payments, approvals, and burns inside this page.

scenes.title: Inspect the instrument and investor registries
sentences: The instrument registry exposes terms, circulating supply, and lifecycle status.
Investor records connect identity, eligibility, and wallets.
We will demonstrate coupon, partial early redemption, and redemption at maturity on synthetic test records.

scenes.title: Coupon: capture, calculate, approve and pay
sentences: We schedule the coupon, capture holders, and calculate rights.
The QA positions are ten, twenty, and five bonds; entitlements total seventeen hundred fifty K Z T test.
The issuer funds and reserves the full budget.
A distinct approver reviews the calculation, then the issuer pays each holder and finalizes the simulated receipt.

scenes.title: Partial early redemption: payment and burn
sentences: Next, we open twenty percent partial redemption.
Capture and calculation produce seven bonds to redeem, with seven thousand K Z T test in payment.
Again, full reserve and separate approval precede execution.
After the three simulated payments and burns, supply changes from thirty five to twenty eight.
In the Solana protocol, each holder payment and burn share one atomic transaction.

scenes.title: Maturity: retire the remaining supply
sentences: Maturity captures the remaining twenty eight bonds in this QA sequence.
Principal plus the final coupon totals twenty nine thousand four hundred K Z T test.
We reserve funds, switch approver, execute the simulated payments, and finalize.
All remaining bonds are burned, final supply is zero, and the instrument becomes redeemed.

scenes.title: Inspect the receipts and read-only audit history
sentences: We download the simulated result and inspect transaction and audit history as an auditor.
QA receipts do not establish blockchain execution.
The production recovery path preserves an unknown operation and its original signature for verification, instead of sending a replacement payment.

scenes.title: Separate proof: four completed Localnet actions
sentences: Separate October twelfth disposable Localnet acceptance completed these four actions.
It includes an additional exact eight unit redemption between percentage redemption and maturity.
That is why its maturity pays twenty one thousand and burns twenty, rather than the QA sequence of twenty eight.
Canonical receipts reconcile finalized cash and token effects.
